commentaire: Only generic shared features (back view, head turned up, knotted cloak). The pose is reversed: on the plate the head turns right (face ~262,284) and the cloak knots near the neck/left side (~267,292); in the engraving the head turns left (beard ~550,3330) and the knot sits on the right shoulder (662,3380). The arm action differs too (plate: arm stretched forward to the right towards the stones; engraving: arm bent and hanging under the cloak, elbow ~760,3500), and so does the drapery (plate: short fluttering cloak; engraving: long tunic and cloak to the ground). No points placed.
